James: Morning — quick async standup

James: what I did: ran the full eval on the synth promptset A, reproduced a ~3% drop in Spanish rerank scores; traced to a tokenizer offset shift after merging tokenizer v2. Opened PR #5432 with a minimal adapter fix and test.

James: blockers: CI flakes on one integration test, need 1-2 reviewers to approve the adapter change, and I don't have infra access for a second GPU for the full sweep.

James: today: triage tokenizer regression, get PR merged, rerun spanish sweep, monitor canary rollout.

Tara: thanks. can you paste one failing example and prompt id? also should we pin tokenizer in model-metadata until this is stable? :eyes:

James: failing example: "¿Cuál es la política de reembolso..." -> model truncates mid-sentence; prompt id synth_spanish_023. Agree on pinning until we confirm.

Evan: i pulled the eval logs — offsets look shifted by +1 for a subset of tokens. repro command i used:
```
python infra/eval.py --model=redwood-3-smallq --prompts=synthetic/spanish/023.json --seed=42
```
Hypothesis: tokenizer v2 changed BOS/SEP mapping; trying a quick adapter patch to remap ids.

Tara: @Evan nice. if it's tokenizer we should pin tokenizer field in model-metadata and add a regression test for spanish long-tail prompts.

Sophia: blocker for me: KV cache warmup for tinyq variant on Dedicated didn't populate in last smoke — saw cold starts for ~80% of requests which spikes tail latency. Need someone to triage deploy config.

Evan: i'll take tinyq cache after i finish the tokenizer patch. quick checklist: ensure `cache_warmup=True` in the deploy config and that the warmup script runs with `--kv-cache` flag + correct model alias.

ci-bot: CI started for PR #5432 — running unit, integration, smoke (estimated 12m).

James: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/5432 — added a unit test that fails before the patch and passes after locally.

Tara: left minor nits on the PR, will approve after CI is green. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for tinyq/2026-03-17 — 10% traffic to canary, will monitor metrics for 30m.

James: plan for today: 1) triage + merge tokenizer adapter fix; 2) run the full spanish sweep (once we have extra GPU); 3) monitor tinyq canary and KV warmup; 4) follow up with infra for extra test GPUs for tomorrow's full sweep.

Evan: noted, i'll update the GH issue with root cause and next steps once i confirm.

Sophia: warmup logs are in s3://redwood-logs/kv-warmup/2026-03-16/ if anyone needs to inspect.

Tara: pinged @infra for extra GPUs. thanks all.
_notes: Single-thread Slack conversation string; messages are chronological and prefixed with sender name as required.
